coaches.name: Eliza Simpson
coaches.description: NYC-based accent coach for actors, voice-over artists and spokespeople. Uses Knight-Thompson Speechwork and offers remote coaching, dialogue support and accent preparation for screen and stage.

coaches.name: Danny Bryck
coaches.description: Dialect coaching for auditions, productions and skill development. Offers individual coaching in NYC and remotely, covering American regional, British and international accents and foreign-language pronunciation.

coaches.name: Shane Ann Younts
coaches.description: NYC dialect coach working with scripts, audition sides and monologues. Sessions address sound changes, rhythm, intonation and vocal flexibility. Inquire directly about delivery, rates and scheduling.

coaches.name: Amy Stoller
coaches.description: NYC-based dialect designer offering private performer coaching through Stoller System. Private sessions take place via Zoom, with attention to articulation, rhythm, character and the cultural context of speech.

coaches.name: Ricardo López-Montilla
coaches.description: Individual and production dialect coaching, offered online or in person in NYC. Listed dialects include RP, Cockney, Estuary, French, Spanish, Russian, German and American varieties. Sliding-scale quotes depend on the work required.

coaches.name: Julie Foh
coaches.description: Voice, text and accent coaching for individual performers and productions. Based in NYC and Connecticut, with remote coaching available through Zoom and other online platforms. Contact directly for project details.

coaches.name: Linda Jones
coaches.description: Private voice, speech and dialect coaching for actors and other communicators. Works on specific accents and transferable accent-learning skills; her official coaching page states that sessions are conducted over Zoom.

coaches.name: Deena Kaye
coaches.description: Manhattan-based audition, vocal and dialect coach. Works with the rhythm and musicality of regional and international accents, with virtual coaching available through Zoom and other platforms.

coaches.name: Cynthia Santos DeCure
coaches.description: New York and Connecticut voice and dialect coach specializing in Spanish accents, Latinx identities and bilingual Shakespeare. Offers bilingual coaching for stage, film and television. Confirm format and availability directly.

coaches.name: Daryll Heysham
coaches.description: New York dialect and accent coach offering one-to-one work through DialectsByDaryll. Contact the coach through the official site for the target accent, coaching format, current rates and scheduling.

coaches.name: Melanie Fox
coaches.description: SpeechFox dialect coaching for actors preparing auditions, sides and scripts. Offers one-to-one sessions online or in person at a Manhattan office, with linguistic analysis and structured practice.

coaches.name: Charley Layton
coaches.description: NYC dialect coach offering private lessons and coaching for theater, film and television. Works with regional and international accents and American English for performers. Contact directly for rates and meeting arrangements.

coaches.name: Patricia Fletcher
coaches.description: Voice and dialect coach helping individual actors and casts integrate sound changes, rhythm and text into character work. Remote speech and dialect coaching is available by Zoom or phone.

coaches.name: Ben Furey
coaches.description: Accent, dialect, voice and text coaching for actors, including audition preparation and dialect work within songs. Available worldwide via Zoom, FaceTime or Skype. Listed here as an online option; a current NYC studio is not asserted.

coaches.name: Erik Singer
coaches.description: New York-based dialect coach for production and ADR work, and a Knight-Thompson Speechwork Master Teacher. His official booking page currently says he is unavailable for private coaching. Contact him about production work or future availability.

coaches.name: Leigh Dillon
coaches.description: New York City accent and dialect coach working with performers and other speakers. Her professional site provides a contact route for coaching inquiries. Confirm rates, delivery format and current availability directly.

coaches.name: Kristen Cerelli
coaches.description: Performance coach offering dialect and accent work. Private coaching is currently via Zoom; NYC meetings are by inquiry. Consult her official booking site for the appropriate service and current availability.

coaches.name: Joel Goldes
coaches.description: Dialect coaching for auditions and screen or stage projects, with written materials and session recordings. Offers private online coaching. Included as a remote option without claiming a NYC studio or local availability.

coaches.name: Elizabeth Abbott
coaches.description: Private online dialect coaching for individual actors, from short audition preparation to ongoing accent study. Offers regional, international and period speech work via FaceTime, Zoom or Skype; no NYC studio is asserted.
